name: Gnomeregan
summary: Troggs and leper gnomes roam Gnomeregan’s poisoned halls among the broken defenses. The city was once the gnomes’ underground capital, until a desperate defense ended in catastrophe.

sections.title: A Wonder of Engineering
sections.body: Gnomeregan’s halls once rang with the work of gnomish engineers. Ironforge dwarves helped build the city centuries ago, carving it into the snowy crags of western Dun Morogh. Steam-driven gears, copper pipes, and vast assembly halls made it the heart of gnomish industry and invention. During the Second War, its designs, flying machines, and complex weapons supplied the Alliance. Even Orgrim Doomhammer’s Horde could not break the city during its siege.

sections.title: The Fall and the Poisoned Halls
sections.body:
During the Third War, troggs surged up from deep underground and broke into Gnomeregan’s lowest chambers. High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque chose to face the invasion alone, unwilling to draw Alliance armies away from the slaughter in Lordaeron.

On the advice of chief engineer Mekgineer Thermaplugg, he ordered radioactive gas released through the lower chambers to wipe out the troggs. Instead, the gas empowered many troggs and killed nearly eighty percent of the gnomish people. Survivors exposed to it became twisted leper gnomes, and Thermaplugg took control of the poisoned ruins.

faq.q: Why is Gnomeregan full of radiation?
faq.answer: High Tinker Mekkatorque released radioactive gas into Gnomeregan’s lower vents as troggs overran the city, following Mekgineer Thermaplugg’s advice. The gas was meant to kill the troggs, but it slaughtered thousands of gnomes, changed survivors into leper gnomes, and left the city permanently irradiated.

faq.q: Where are all the surviving gnomes now?
faq.answer: Surviving gnomes fled to Ironforge, where King Magni Bronzebeard gave them refuge in the Tinkers’ Court. High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque works there to aid his scattered people and plan their return home.

aliases: who is the boss of gnomeregan
faq.answer: Mekgineer Thermaplugg controls Gnomeregan and has declared himself its king. Once Mekkatorque’s chief advisor, he commands rogue defense automatons, irradiated leper gnomes, and mutant troggs from deep within the city’s core.

faq.q: Why didn't the Alliance help save Gnomeregan during the invasion?
faq.answer: Mekkatorque chose not to ask the Alliance for help. As the Scourge ravaged humanity during the Third War, the gnomes kept their struggle underground secret rather than draw vital defenders away from Lordaeron.

angles.text: For gnomes, Gnomeregan’s loss remains a deep wound. Entering its irradiated halls is a solemn pilgrimage to destroy Thermaplugg and recover lost mechanical heirlooms.
Though radioactive poison chokes Gnomeregan, it holds the Eastern Kingdoms’ greatest concentration of schematics, advanced spare parts, and working industrial machinery.
